# Bitcoin Miner Studio v2.0.2 — Updated Windows Build

**Download:** [BitcoinMinerStudio-v2.0.2-Windows-x64.zip](https://github.com/bubblegump30/bitcoin-miner-studio/releases/download/v2.0.2/BitcoinMinerStudio-v2.0.2-Windows-x64.zip)

Extract the ZIP and run `BitcoinMinerStudio.exe` on Windows 10/11. Python is included; Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required.

This signed build adds optional, editable Braiins Pool and CKPool Solo presets in Pool Profiles and fixes Windows packaging reliability. Choosing a preset only fills the endpoint and fee assumption after explicit review; saving, testing and activation stay separate. BTC PoW Lab is deferred pending documented terms.

Verify the ZIP using `SHA256SUMS-Windows.txt`. Purple Dragon Security should report **TRUSTED · 73/73 protected files**. The Windows EXE does not have a Microsoft Authenticode signature.

The updated binary was built from [signed source commit aecc2ea](https://github.com/bubblegump30/bitcoin-miner-studio/commit/aecc2ea1a94ea916839bc7ba94e9834670bf1098).
